title: Bell investigating cyberattack behind days-long email outage in Manitoba, CTV reports
summary: CTV News Winnipeg reported on 23 November that a days-long email outage in Manitoba the previous week was the result of a cyberattack. The headline says Bell is investigating the cyberattack. The page read gave no Bell statement, no scope and no cause.
plain: CTV News Winnipeg reports a days-long email outage in Manitoba last week was caused by a cyberattack, and that Bell is investigating. The page gave no further details.
exec: CTV reports a days-long Manitoba email outage was a cyberattack under Bell's investigation; no scope was given.

validation.note: One short CTV video page read; it carries no direct Bell statement. Searches found no second report and no Bell page. CTV News Winnipeg and Bell share a parent company.
